title: SP-Microservice: a containerised service as a block with connectors

sp.name: SP-Microservice
covers: Services on Amazon ECS (Fargate), any language
Connectors: gRPC and REST calls with contract, deadline, retries, idempotency and read or write; publish and consume (through SP-Kafka and the queue packs); database
Inside view: hexagonal adapters, ports and domain, generated from the connectors, with an Envoy sidecar
Scale-out: copies, state, scheduled work; scale state on the block during a demand run
SLO per service: availability and p99 latency
not_covered: Kubernetes (EKS), VMs and Lambda runtimes: legacy behaviour
Service mesh configuration (Envoy routes) as code
Contract tests (Pact) generated from the connectors

integration.carries: Protocol (gRPC inside, REST at the edge), contract, deadline, retries, idempotency key, read or write
REST (HTTPS + JSON) with an OpenAPI contract
Use REST or gRPC-Web through a proxy
SQL over TLS; other services use its API or events

integration.means: Publish (through an outbox when it also writes its database)
integration.carries: Key, event and version, delivery guarantee

facts.label: Application Load Balancer to targets over gRPC
facts.note: By default HTTP/1.1; the target group's protocol version can be HTTP/2 or gRPC.

facts.label: Deployment circuit breaker
facts.note: Rolling-update deployments only; must be enabled explicitly; can roll back to the last deployment that completed.

rules.rationale: Services that call each other in a circle fail together and multiply retries.
rules.fix: Insert a queue on the closing call (make it asynchronous).

rules.rationale: Each synchronous hop adds latency and failure; keep chains short.
rules.fix: No automatic fix: make the last call an event, call it earlier, or keep a local copy from events. Can be accepted with a reason.

rules.rationale: A callee's deadline must be shorter than its caller's.
rules.fix: Shorten the callee's deadline to 60% of the caller's.

rules.rationale: A call without a deadline turns a slow service into an outage upstream.
Retrying a write without an idempotency key can apply it twice.
Retries at several layers multiply load when a service struggles.
rules.fix: Retry only at the first hop.

rules.rationale: A database per service keeps services independent.
rules.fix: No automatic fix: move the other services to the owner's API or events.

rules.rationale: One copy stops the service on a deployment, a crash or a zone failure.
Copies that keep state in memory disagree and lose it when scaling in.
rules.fix: No automatic fix: keep state in a database or cache.

rules.rationale: Scheduled work inside every copy runs once per copy.
Calls without a versioned contract break at run time instead of in a contract test.
rules.fix: No automatic fix: name the .proto or OpenAPI contract.

rules.rationale: Browsers and most partners cannot call gRPC directly.
A service cannot be more available than all the services it needs together.
rules.fix: No automatic fix: raise the dependencies' targets or degrade gracefully.
